newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Body of Busang geologist found - airport official.
newsitem.headline: Body of Busang geologist found - airport official.

text.p: The body of Filipino geologist Michael de Guzman, who fell from a helicopter on his way to the huge Busang gold property he helped discover in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province, has been found, an official said on Monday.

"Search and rescue officials found his body at around 12.30 p.m. (0530 GMT) yesterday about 25 nautical miles from Samarinda," Sugianto, chief of the airport in the East Kalimantan capital of Samarinda, told Reuters by telephone.
"There have been no further details from the rescue officials," Sugianto said. "I have sent a helicopter to the location to bring the body back to Samarinda."

Sugianto said last Friday that de Guzman may have committed suicide as one of the several letters found in a bag he had left behind in the Alouette 3 helicopter was addressed to his wife saying that he was suffering from acute hepatitis B.

Search and Rescue officials said last week de Guzman was missing after the back door of the helicopter burst open 17 minutes after taking off last Wednesday morning from Samarinda airport on its way to the Busang property in the Kutai regency.

They said the helicopter had been chartered by Canadian company Bre-X Minerals Ltd where de Guzman was chief geologist, from PT Indonesia Air Transport and was piloted by Captain Eddy Tursono, who was accompanied by an engineer.
